newsitem.title: USA: Universal returns to court in legal fight.
newsitem.headline: Universal returns to court in legal fight.

text.p: Universal Automotive Industries Inc said Tuesday it will be returning to court in a legal dispute with a bankrupt company after a proposed settlement was rejected by some of the company's creditors.
Universal said in a statement that creditors refused to accept the settlement agreement it had reached with the Estate of National Parts Exchange Inc and let the agreement lapse.
Under the terms of the agreement, Universal would have paid the estate $650,000 to cover the damages sought in its lawsuit against Universal, it said.
"Some of them apparently deemed it (the amount) to be insufficient," said an official at Universal.
In 1995, the estate sued Universal in a dispute over the buying and selling of automotive parts.
Universal, which makes brake rotors and other brake parts, said in the statement it expected to return to court sometime in the fourth quarter.
A company often transforms itself into an estate after it goes bankrupt.
